nodes.title: Membership on 10 dates matches the independent published record
A 2-for-1 split with no price move gives zero returns
A 1% dividend lifts total return 1% above price return
A delisted stock keeps its final return and nothing after
A missing member-day is flagged; exchange closures are not
Bad bars, a zero close and a duplicate are flagged; rows are kept
An unexplained +60% jump is flagged; a split-day −50% is not
Five stale days are flagged; a four-day halt is not
The DATA-03 coverage check passes at 19 of 20 and fails at 18 of 20
An update adds only new days and logs a planted vendor correction
An interrupted then resumed full run equals an uninterrupted one
Planted one-factor panel gives the known top-eigenvalue share each year
The loader never returns the future and refuses the holdout
Live progress arrives in order within 2 seconds, starting with a snapshot
Progress survives a reload; a second start and a down backend show clear messages
Update, EDA and the full explorer

acceptance: Each type is code in `data/types.py` (pandera schemas for frames); each `tests/contracts/data.<Type>/` sample validates
Every PL-09 and PL-11 step, `Loader`, `start_run`, `tail_progress` and `runs.emit` import with their signatures, bodies `raise NotImplementedError("<task>")`; `data/__init__.py` exports the contract
Fixture-backed fakes of `data.Loader`, `data.start_run` and `data.tail_progress` serve their samples for server's tests
`EdaReport` is code in `research/types.py`; the `tests/contracts/research.EdaReport/` sample validates
`load_eda_report` imports with its signature, body `raise NotImplementedError("M1-T17")`; a fake serving the sample exists for server's tests
Pydantic models in `server/schemas.py`; JSON Schema exported to each `tests/contracts/server.<Type>/` with one JSON sample per listed case, each validating
PL-13 steps import with signatures, bodies `raise NotImplementedError("<task>")`; a fixture server replays the samples (HTTP and `/ws/progress`) for web's tests
`ApiClient`, `ProgressFeed`, `Route` are TypeScript in `src/api/types.ts`; server types generated from `tests/contracts/server.*` schemas compile
Every PL-14 step exports its signature, body `throw new Error("<task>")`
The three download steps (one module) read Sharadar-format bulk files from `raw/`, no network, and return schema-valid outputs on the samples
TC-01 passes on real data (skips with a stated reason until a Sharadar download exists); its oracle parse test passes on two hand-checked dates
The rename and two-share-class cases of the `data.Membership` sample hold (UNIV-03)
TC-02, TC-03 and TC-04 pass within tolerance; plain close-to-close stays selectable as the baseline
The `closeadj` cross-check flags `adjustment_mismatch` above 1e-4
TC-11 passes; `load_stored` and `save_flags` (same module) round-trip the samples
The run record lists attempted, succeeded, failed-with-reason and rows added; store size is recorded for QR-07
On the samples, coverage returns a `CoverageReport`, each flag step (same module) returns its input, `build_report` returns a valid `ValidationReport`
A `Loader` over the store sample answers `membership`, `prices`, `returns` and `changes`, returning nothing dated after `as_of`
`start_run` takes a SQLite lock and raises `RunInProgressError` while held; `emit` then `tail_progress` returns the events in `seq` order
`create_app` on the `data.Loader` fake returns an `App` bound to 127.0.0.1:8765 with the error mapping; `serve` (same module) runs it under uvicorn
Each S1 dataset route answers from the `data.Loader` and `research.load_eda_report` fakes with a schema-valid payload

nodes.title: Run routes, one run at a time

acceptance: `POST /api/runs` starts a run through the `data.start_run` fake (202); `GET /api/runs/{id}` returns a valid `RunDetail`
Given a run in progress, a second `POST` returns 409 "a run is already in progress" with the running run's ID
On the `data.tail_progress` fake: a snapshot first on connect, then events in `seq` order with none missing, a heartbeat every 10 s
Each event is sent ≤ 2 s after its `ts` (QR-05)
Against the fixture server, the client fetches samples and `connectProgress` yields the snapshot, then events
When the socket drops, the feed shows "reconnecting", retries with backoff and applies the new snapshot
Returns the newest `results/eda/*/report.json` as an `EdaReport`; raises `FileNotFoundError` when none exists
Renders the member-count line and monthly entries and exits from the `server.UniverseResponse` sample
Search lists every `server.StockMatch` sample; the chart shows close, total-return index, volume and the action, flag and membership markers
Renders the `server.FlagsPage` sample as a paged table
Renders the `server.Coverage` sample as tables, the former-member pass or fail first
Lists the sample report's captioned sections; a 404 shows "run `qrp research eda`"
Start buttons post to the fixture server; the panel shows done/total from `ProgressFeed` events; a 409 shows "a run is already in progress"
`qrp data full --smoke` runs end to end on a synthetic `raw/` folder under a run ID; committed as PL-09's smoke test
PL-09's entry sketch replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`qrp data validate --smoke` runs end to end on the PL-09 smoke store; committed as PL-11's smoke test
PL-11's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`qrp serve --smoke` starts on the data and research fakes, hits each S1 route once and exits; committed as PL-13's smoke test
PL-13's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`npm run smoke --prefix packages/web` opens every S1 route against the fixture server; the offline banner shows when it is down
PL-14's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
Against a recorded-response HTTP fake: bulk export fetched, tickers mapped to permaticker, history from 3 years before entry, 5 retries with backoff, then the failure recorded
With no API key or no network, a clear error and an unchanged store
TC-09 passes: 19 of 20 passes, 18 of 20 fails, a 5-day gap counts as covered
TC-05 passes (one missing flag; the Sandy closure days not flagged); TC-08 passes (`flag_stale`: 5 stale, a 4-day halt not)
TC-06 passes (bars, zero close, duplicates flagged; rows kept); TC-07 passes (`flag_jumps`: +60% flagged, split-day −50% not)
Given flags of known types, the report counts by type, security and year and states the flagged share
Given a flagged share above 0.5%, `top_contributors` lists the largest contributors
The server's run routes and broadcast call the real `data.start_run` and `data.tail_progress`; web runs on the real server; the fakes stay for contract tests
TC-14 and TC-15 pass on the real chain; all four smoke commands pass
